hero.headline:
The Git Client
You Actually Own
hero.subheadline: A beautiful, fast, native Git client for your desktop. Free to use and built for developers.
hero.freeBadge: Free to use · macOS, Windows and Linux

graph.title: Visual Commit Graph
graph.desc: See your entire repository history at a glance. Color-coded swimlanes, merge lines, and branch labels — rendered at 60fps on a native Canvas.

staging.title: Hunk-level Staging
staging.desc: Stage individual hunks or even single lines. Review every change before it goes in — with a Monaco-powered diff viewer.

worktrees.title: Git Worktrees
worktrees.desc: Work on multiple branches simultaneously without stashing. Bough manages all your worktrees from one sidebar.

local.title: Your Repositories, Your Desktop
local.desc: Work with your local Git repositories without a cloud account.

native.title: Native, Not Electron
native.desc: Built with Go and native WebView — not Chromium. Bough launches in under a second and uses a fraction of the RAM of Electron apps.

performance.title: Built for Performance
performance.desc: Optimized from the ground up to handle massive repositories with thousands of commits. Instant diff rendering, blazing-fast search.

download.title: Bough is free
